name: zigzag
description: A fixed zigzag: the stick jumps to a new displacement every 7 steps, through 12 vectors (axis-aligned, diagonal, and deflections below the full 42 px: 33%, 67%, 71%, 77%, 87%, 94%), and the 84-step cycle repeats. Exercises the normalisation of inputVector with magnitudes below 1 and the velocity / acceleration terms of the player's movement.
